enemy_observer_interpretation.raw_irq_hold_rule: Retain and report exact published-pose run lengths; no fixed 8-IRQ acceptance threshold.

source_contract.player_timer_behavior: player_animation_tick decrements PLAYER_ANIM_TIMER once per scheduled tick and reloads 8 at expiry; adaptive_tick_binding invokes it once on each logical simulation tick.
source_contract.enemy_timer_behavior: enemy_tick_impl decrements ENEMY_TIMER once per scheduled gameplay tick and reloads 8 while incrementing ENEMY_ANIM modulo 4; roaming and dormant drawing share enemy_frame_number.
source_contract.cache_temporary_write: build_enemy_nest_cache saves ENEMY_ANIM, temporarily writes 0..3, then restores it; raw IRQ ENEMY_ANIM is excluded from phase classification.
source_contract.timer_origin_formula: AD_SIM_TIME - (8 - PLAYER_ANIM_TIMER), modulo 65536, from exact source timer reload/decrement behavior.
source_contract.enemy_timer_origin_formula: AD_SIM_TIME - (8 - ENEMY_TIMER), modulo 65536, sampled only at stable AD_DISPATCH_WORK boundaries.
